chunks: And Wuhayb ibn Ḥafṣ narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a boy who entered the house of some people to play, then fell into their well. Are they liable? He said: They are not liable; but if they are under suspicion, they are liable.

key_terms.دَارَ قَوْمٍ: the home or property of a group of people
key_terms.مُتَّهَمِينَ: suspected of fault, negligence, or wrongdoing
key_terms.يَضْمَنُونَ: they bear liability or financial responsibility

ai.seo_question: Are homeowners liable if a child enters their property and falls into their well?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning liability when a child falls into a well located in another person's property. The default ruling is that the property owners are not liable, but liability is established if they are considered suspected of wrongdoing or negligence.
